notablePrerequisites: Apprentice Necromancer does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Basal Sliver by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Apprentice Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping and sacrificing it, targeting Basal Sliver.
Ashnod triggers, copying Apprentice Necromancer's ability, targeting Apprentice Necromancer.
Resolve both Apprentice Necromancer abilities, returning Apprentice Necromancer and Basal Sliver from your graveyard to the battlefield, and giving them haste until end of turn.
Repeat.
